summary: Tested prosumator AI import + document generation end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass (+1 AI test passed in an earlier run, skipped on rerun to save cost). AI extract on /tmp/antal.pdf returned correct fields (ZOLTAN ANTAL, CNP, POD, power, inverter) + storage file. Import creates prosumator(PROS-YYYY-NNN)/client(no dup)/works/mono/3 equipment/documents. All 11 doc types + 'all' (11 pages) return valid PDFs; 404 unknown type/id/other user, 401 no/bad token. Sizing tri vs mono correct (4P/2P, 3P+N+PE/1P+N+PE), warning when inverter_kw > bransament_kw. Settings cui/regcom/anre_attest persist and appear in PDF header. Frontend: AI import button uploads PDF, toast, opens prefilled form; Save on new calls /import/prosumator (PROS-2026-004 created, then cleaned up); edit Antal shows generated-docs panel with 12 links + attached-file, all return application/pdf. Antal visible in Prosumator, Clienți, Lucrări, Documente; Scheme monofilare shows SM-PROS-2026-003; Echipamente has Solis/Aiko/Ecobat rows. Regression CRUD diu/panels/anti/pram/power/projects OK.

minor.issue: Number = count+1 -> duplicate numbers possible after deletions (e.g. delete 002 then import -> new 003 duplicates existing). Also no duplicate-dossier check: importing the same PDF twice creates duplicate prosumator + works + mono + equipment + documents records.
No cascade: works/mono/equipment/documents created by import (pros_ref) stay orphaned when dossier deleted.
d.setdefault('number') keeps empty string if frontend sends number:'' (user typed then cleared) -> dossier without number. Use `if not d.get('number')`.
Main breaker sized on max(i_br, i_inv): for mono 3 kW branșament + 5 kW inverter gives BMP 32 A (exceeds branșament). Warning is shown, but consider sizing main from branșament only.

ui_bugs.issue: Inputs editable before GET /settings resolves; typed values are overwritten by the async load (race). Disable inputs / show loader until loaded.
On a new (unsaved) form 'Dosar complet (PDF)' button still rendered with href /api/docs/all/null -> 404 when clicked. Hide it when !id.

issues: Search icon overlaps placeholder text ('Caută...') – .den-input padding:10px 12px overrides Tailwind pl-9 (computed padding-left 12px).
Checklist header reads 'Checklist documente DI-U' on the prosumator form – should be module-specific.
Imported equipment rows don't show client/dossier, so user can't tell which beneficiary they belong to.

action_items: Hide doc-all link when record not saved (id null)
Fix search input padding (icon overlaps placeholder)
Make prosumator numbering robust (max existing number +1) and treat empty number as missing
Optionally warn on duplicate import (same POD/client) and cascade-delete pros_ref records
Prevent Settings form edits before data load
critical_code_review_comments: ai_extract endpoint stores the file in object storage before AI extraction; on 502 the file is orphaned (minor)
No file size limit on /ai/extract and /upload
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with token in query string (?auth=) for PDFs — token leaks into browser history/logs; acceptable for MVP
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_PROS records, the UI-created duplicate PROS-2026-004 (and its works/mono/equipment/documents) and 2 registered test_pros_* users were deleted. Settings restored to original (anre_attest '23982 (tip B)', cui/regcom empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && SKIP_AI=1 REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_prosumator_docs.py -n0 (must run serially; tests share state). Antal prosumator id 3f6fd4d4-f603-4880-9a11-304820c2d3e3 (PROS-2026-003) is real data – don't delete. Routes are Romanian: /clienti /lucrari /mono /echipamente /documente /setari. AI extract took ~20s on the 7.6MB PDF. Settings test in pytest restores original values; be careful not to blank anre_attest.
